text:
Alex: Started canary for feature flag dynamic-routing->v2 at 02:10 PDT. Rolling to 5% in us-west-2. @Maria @Liam quick sanity check? deploy-bot logged: canary_id=cr-20260315-1

Maria: Thanks — grabbing dashboards. Key things to watch: 95p latency, error-rate, rerank quality.

Liam-SRE: looking... seeing small spike in 5xxs on routing-proxy: +0.7% over baseline starting 02:14. Investigating logs. If it stays >1% for 5m we should pause.

Sara-QA: ran smoke prompt-suite against v2, see slight tokenization diff in reranker output on one test — not a blocker but flagged. Test id: rerank_smoke_07

Jon: FYI, feature flag is using gradual rollout via LaunchDarkly. Current targeting: users with country=US and beta_group=true.

Alex: thanks. Liam — if spike hits 1% can you pause? There's auto-fallback to v1 but that needs manual flip.

Liam-SRE: Pause done at 02:18 PDT — manual pause toggle used. Can confirm traffic back to v1. 5xxs trending down.

deploy-bot: canary cr-20260315-1 status=paused by Liam-SRE at 1760001518

Maria: Good catch. Can we get logs correlating requests that hit v2? Also can ops add a label for customer-facing incidents if we need to notify.

Alex: I'll pull request a log slice and create a short postmortem if we need. For now I'll revert the flag rollout until we have root cause. @Sara-QA can you run the rerank suite against v1 to confirm no regression?

Sara-QA: Running now, will post results in ~15m.

Jon: Noted — I won't advance the rollout. Also let's document that the v2 model changed tokenization and needs a preprocessor tweak.

Liam-SRE: 5xxs stable at baseline. No additional alerts. If QA is green we can try a smaller 1% canary with extra logging.

Maria: Agree. Add a canary checklist item: new-metrics + synthetic keys.

Alex: ok I'll open a PR for a patch: preprocessor tweak + extra logging, then request a 1% canary. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Sara-QA: rerank_smoke_07 passed on v1; rerank_smoke_07 still failing on v2 per earlier. QA green on v1.

Alex: filed PR #4523 and will schedule a new canary after approvals.

Liam-SRE: marking incident as mitigated. No customer impact reported.

Maria: I'll draft a short internal note for CS just in case.

Alex: closing thread for now — will update when new canary starts.
